snippet.title: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots Of Evil - World Premiere Trailer| Harvest of Terror 2026
snippet.description:
Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil is a disturbing survival horror game set in the 19th century. You play as a detective, tormented by a recent loss, who must use his wits and instincts to unravel a gruesome crime and survive the unspeakable horrors lurking in an ancient, isolated monastery. Explore hidden chambers, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that lurk in its shadowy halls.

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002550/Shadow_Sacrament_The_Roots_of_Evil/

Eldritch House:
https://x.com/eldritchhousegs
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
